output.arguments:
{"code":"def transform(grid):
    a=[r[:] for r in grid]
    h=len(a); w=len(a[0])
    # find largest solid rectangular monochrome object
    from collections import Counter
    pts=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c]!=0]
    if not pts: return a
    # choose color with largest count
    cnt=Counter(grid[r][c] for r,c in pts)
    col=max(cnt,key=cnt.get)
    q=[(r,c) for r,c in pts if grid[r][c]==col]
    r0=min(r for r,c in q); r1=max(r for r,c in q); c0=min(c for r,c in q); c1=max(c for r,c in q)
    # paint row below-object code aligned to object columns onto bottom row
    for c in range(c0,c1+1):
        if r1+1<h and grid[r1+1][c]!=0:
            a[r1][c]=grid[r1+1][c]
    # singleton marker to left of top row: transfer it to top-left object cell
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(c0):
            if grid[r][c]!=0 and r==r0:
                a[r0][c0]=grid[r][c]
    return a"}

{"code":"def transform(grid):
    a=[r[:] for r in grid]; h=len(grid); w=len(grid[0])
    from collections import Counter
    cells=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c]]
    if not cells:return a
    co=Counter(grid[r][c] for r,c in cells); color=max(co,key=co.get)
    q=[(r,c) for r,c in cells if grid[r][c]==color]
    r0=min(r for r,c in q); r1=max(r for r,c in q); c0=min(c for r,c in q); c1=max(c for r,c in q)
    # aligned colored key row below rectangle
    for rr in range(r1+1,h):
        if all(grid[rr][c]!=0 for c in range(c0,c1+1)):
            for c in range(c0,c1+1): a[r1][c]=grid[rr][c]
            break
    # left-hand marker aligned with top edge transfers to top-left
    for c in range(c0):
        if grid[r0][c]!=0: a[r0][c0]=grid[r0][c]
    return a"}
